Completed the VibeSim simulation optimization on branch `fix/qwen3-before-copy-inputs`.

Diagnosis: the largest redundant subtree was `unified.qk_norm`. Before, it emitted `q_input_copy`, `q_norm`, `k_input_copy`, and `k_norm`; the two copy leaves had empty necessary-work semantics. The scope measured R0 was `0.00047138` GPU-seconds versus R5 `0.00008876849537500001` and R6/R7 `1.792e-9` (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`, `pred.casev1.optimality-kernel-ladder`; [before scope](tmp/qwen3-redundant-work/before_qk_scope.json)). These copies only moved intermediate Q/K data and contributed no required model work; the q/k RMSNorm computation remains necessary.

Fix: [qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/arch/qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs:14) now sets `BeforeRecipe::COPY_INPUTS` to `false`. Its test verifies both optional copies are absent while q/k norms, head multipliers, dimensions, projections, layer count, and KV sizing remain unchanged. [The model.work map](/workspace/model/work/location_maps/qwen3_dense_vllm_before_unified.json:3) was versioned to v2 and removes only the deleted zero-semantic locations, preserving all 14 semantic rows so R6/R7 remain attributable.

Evidence: after the same `before.json` prediction, the qk_norm scope is R0 `0.00027274799999999996`, R5 `0.0000443842525`, and R6/R7 `1.792e-9` GPU-seconds ([after scope](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_iter_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_55d4ec34f709.json)). Its leaf list is now exactly `unified.qk_norm.q_norm` and `unified.qk_norm.k_norm`; the final operation trees contain no copy leaves (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`, `pred.casev1.operationv0.cost-tree`). Overall simulated totals changed from 4.066712856292724 ms to 3.952183246612549 ms for prefill and from 1.7964478731155396 ms to 1.7123689651489258 ms for decode (`pred.overview`).

Both predictions used `TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp/qwen3-redundant-work CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' uv run python -m launcher timing-predict eval-configs/before.json`, with no `--profile`; `profiling/profile.db` remained unchanged at SHA-256 `b5de34770938f526cb5de7d7e1b450bb79f6f393db89bc1268609a47b376f0f4`. Focused Rust, model.work, and Analyzer map tests passed. The broader CPU suite still has unrelated environment/fixture failures, and `cargo-fmt` is unavailable.
